review.calibrationAction: Deterministic data correction: verify the exact card minute from the event timeline rather than inferring it from the lineup panel. For red cards before minute 30, open a separate over-watch branch after 10-15 minutes of post-card stabilization and reprice the live total as the line decays. Do not automatically bet the over; require current score, minute, odds, post-card chance quality and settlement-weighted edge.
